bash: cd /app && jq -n --slurpfile u users.json --slurpfile r active_users_report.json '
  ($u[0] | map(select(.status=="active"))) as $act
  | ($r[0]) as $rep
  | {
      same_count: (($act|length) == ($rep|length)),
      ids_match: (($act|map(.id)|sort) == ($rep|map(.user_id)|sort)),
      all_fields_ok: ([ $rep[] as $x | ($act[] | select(.id==$x.user_id)) as $s
          | ($x.username == $s.username) and ($x.email == $s.email)
            and ($x.last_login == ($s.last_login[0:10]))
            and ($x.role_count == ($s.roles|length))
            and ($x.primary_role == ($s.roles[0] // null)) ] | all),
      only_active: ([ $rep[] as $x | ($u[0][] | select(.id==$x.user_id) | .status) ]
                     | unique)
    }'
